portfolio.title: QuickChat
portfolio.description: A high-performance TCP client-server chat application utilizing asynchronous I/O to handle multiple concurrent connections. Implements strict RAII principles for resilient socket and thread management.

portfolio.title: Sudoku Solver & GUI
portfolio.description: A cross-platform Sudoku desktop game with an intuitive UI highlighting real-time row, column, and block conflicts. Features rapid puzzle generation and solving via recursive backtracking and bitwise constraint validation.

portfolio.title: Mazer 3D Engine
portfolio.description: A real-time 3D raycasting engine rendered directly in the terminal console with vector-based player movement, collision detection, and texture shading. Interfaced with an open-source console window engine for high modularity.
